recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: twenty years of a pocket OS still being opened up
proofs riding along with every function call
san francisco morning clear at fourteen degrees
agent shortcuts waking from a phone tap
shipping something before the sun climbs

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Swipe between fog lanes on a clearing bay morning, collecting glowing proof tokens that snap into a growing geometric diagram before the sun hits twenty-eight.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: swipe left or right to change lanes
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: watching the proof diagram complete in under a minute feels like a tiny solved puzzle
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog thins, lanes narrow, tokens drift faster and spawn in tighter clusters
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: muted bay fog watercolor with neon proof lines

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap in rhythm as twenty tiny retro desktop windows boot one after another; miss a beat and a window corrupts into a glitch sprite you must tap to purge.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: booting all twenty windows in one cascade before the timer ends
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: boot tempo accelerates and corrupt windows stack if ignored
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: beige RISC-era pixel desktop with CRT flicker

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw paths on screen to route agent shortcuts from a phone icon through GitHub Actions to a terminal; each successful route deposits a pixel of sunrise on the horizon.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to draw and release to commit a route
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: filling the skyline with sunrise pixels in thirty seconds of shipping
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: more agents spawn simultaneously, demanding split paths and shorter deadlines
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: flat vector gradient sunrise over a minimalist toolchain map

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick lemma shards into shrinking type holes before they expire; a wrong match shatters the shard into fragments you drag-sort back into place.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: flick toward holes, drag to reorder broken shards
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: one unbroken proof chain locked in before the timer runs out
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: holes shrink, lemmas spin, and mismatches spawn extra fragments
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: chalkboard mathematical scribbles with glass shard physics
